title: UpdateLog
description: Append-only run ledger of an organize archive. Each entry records which workers ran (the sidecar header EXTRACTOR must be one of them — the orchestrator never writes sidecars or structured JSON), the input hashes the run saw, what was added/removed, and every degraded/redispatched worker. Freshness is judged by content hashes, never by file mtimes. Not to be confused with library/update_log.json (reference-library ledger, different shape).

at.description: When the run wrote this entry, UTC ISO-8601 (…Z). readiness.as_of_run_date is the LOCAL run date, so the two may differ by one calendar day; the validator allows ±1 day.

run_mode.description: As the organize flow names the run: full / legacy_upgrade (an archive written under an earlier contract brought to the current one: EVERY original re-transcribed by Phase 1 under the 12-key header, then Phase 2 — a partial upgrade does not exist; an older ledger may record the same run as full) / incremental (legacy_phase2_only never appears here: a legacy archive's Phase-2-only pass writes no v1 entry) / upload_reconciliation / faithfulness_patch / relevance_disposition (段E decisions, recorded in removed[] + note by the Phase 2 worker) / conversation_incremental. Open string so a host-specific mode does not fail the ledger. Sidecar scoping distinguishes full and legacy_upgrade (every sidecar is held to the current header) from everything else. A Phase-2-only rewrite of a legacy archive keeps the legacy schema_version numbers and writes no organize_meta.json, so the archive stays legacy (read leniently, WARN).

phase.description: phase1 / phase1_retry / phase1_digest / stub / phase2 / phase2_5 / segment_c / segment_d … (open string).

files.description: source_id / file_id / sidecar paths this worker was given or wrote.

inputs.description: Every input the run reconciled, keyed by the same sha256 as source_inventory.files[].sha256.

outputs.description: Optional: sha256 of each structured output as the flow wrote it. A later mismatch means the file was edited outside the organize flow.
